browser.environment: T3 collaborative Chromium preview, Linux, local Python Handler server; synthetic observation subprocess at accelerated one-second intervals; normal headset SSH disabled during start/stop/download verification
observations: Opened #powerReport and verified labeled duration selector, disabled Stop/downloads before start and accessible sample progress.
Started a synthetic observation and observed 11 of 12 samples in progress; completion allowed another start.
Started again, observed progress, stopped, and saw 7 of 12 samples retained with explicit incomplete state and original frame alias.
Clicked HTML download and saw the UI acknowledge the request; T3's download list did not record the blob download, so filesystem save was not verified.
Fetched all three authenticated export endpoints in the browser: HTML 200 (7599 characters), JSON 200 (2618 characters, 7 samples), CSV 200 (977 characters); each retained the stop reason.

realFrame.lock: ssh frame 'mkdir /tmp/frame-test.lock' succeeded before real-device probe; this task removed only that owned empty lock with rmdir after verification
realFrame.probe: Ran the production desktop Observation using strict, batch SSH to frame. The first attempt exposed a missing structured reason on early remote lock refusal; fixed and reran successfully.
realFrame.result: 0 of 12 samples; running=false; stopped='Smoke session active (/tmp/frame-test.lock); no sensors read'. Exported HTML included the same incomplete reason.
realFrame.scope: Lock refusal only. No successful real sensor session, installation, app launch/stop, power control or thermal control was performed for this feature.

limitations: Native Electron installers were not built or launched; resource staging and build-hook contracts were tested.
One latest report is retained only in server memory. Starting again, restarting the server or quitting discards it; the UI warns users to download first.
Stopping ends only the owned local SSH process. The bounded remote reader discovers closure on its next write; immediate remote cancellation is not guaranteed.
Phone-hosted observation starts are unsupported; the shared server bundle still imports without desktop sampler resources.
